targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(fecha, $interval) as time, count(*) as eventos FROM logs.logs WHERE $__timeFilter(fecha) and (country in ($country) or country is null) GROUP BY time ORDER BY TIME
SELECT $__timeGroup(fecha, $interval) as time, count(distinct COUNTRY) as usuarios FROM logs.logs WHERE $__timeFilter(fecha) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeGroup(fecha, $interval) as time, AVG(minutos) AS minutos 
FROM logs.logs where $__timeFilter(fecha) and (country in ($country) or country is null) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

WITH piezas AS (
  SELECT pieza
  FROM logs.logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(fecha)
    AND pieza IS NOT NULL
    AND country IN ($country)
    AND catalogo != 'Estandar'
  GROUP BY pieza
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
datos_agrupados AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(l.fecha, '$interval') AS time,
    l.pieza,
    COUNT(*) as total_diario
  FROM logs.logs l
  JOIN piezas tp ON l.pieza = tp.pieza
  WHERE $__timeFilter(l.fecha) AND country IN ($country)
  GROUP BY time, l.pieza 
)
SELECT
  time,
  pieza,
  total_diario,
  SUM(total_diario) OVER (PARTITION BY pieza ORDER BY time) AS Total
FROM datos_agrupados
ORDER BY pieza, time;

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(fecha, $interval)  AS time,
  country,
  COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM logs.logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(fecha) AND country is not null and country in ($country)
GROUP BY time, country
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(fecha, '7d')  AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM logs.logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(fecha)  and (country in ($country) or country is null)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(Fecha, '%Y-%m') as fecha,
  sum(minutos)/ 60.0 AS horas
FROM logs
WHERE  country in ($country) and $__timeFilter(fecha) 
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(Fecha, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY fecha;

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(fecha, $interval)  AS time,
  EVENTO,
  COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM logs.logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(fecha) AND country is not null and country in ($country) and Evento IN ('CARGAR_DISEÑO', 'CREAR_DISEÑO')
GROUP BY time, Evento
ORDER BY time
select region, count(*) from logs WHERE $__timeFilter(fecha) AND country is not null and country in ($country) GROUP BY region ORDER BY 2 desc limit 10

SELECT
    logs.lat AS latitude,                             
    logs.lng AS longitude,                           
    COUNT(DISTINCT logs.Usuario) AS unique_users     
FROM logs.logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(logs.Fecha) and (country in ($country) or country is null)                    
GROUP BY logs.lat, logs.lng    
ORDER BY unique_users DESC
